structure.layout: npm workspaces monorepo (packages/*, apps/*), ESM, Node >=22.18, package name frisson
structure.language: TypeScript ~5.8.3; the API runs .ts directly via node

packages.apps/web: @frisson/web. Vue 3, Vue Router, Pinia SPA on Vite 6. Typecheck with vue-tsc. Sources in apps/web/src (components, views, stores, composables, utils, forms, router, App).
packages.apps/api: @frisson/api. Fastify 5 with zod type provider. SQLite via better-sqlite3 and drizzle-orm. Tests in apps/api/test.
packages.packages/shared: @frisson/shared. Zod schemas and sorting. Typecheck only.

structure.buildSystem: Root scripts: dev, build, typecheck, test, lint (eslint .), format, format:check. Playwright ^1.65 is a root dev dependency.

tests.notes: Run from the repo root. Single file: npm test -w apps/web -- src/views/CrateView.test.ts. Typecheck: npm run typecheck. Lint: npm run lint.
tests.browser: No Playwright config or e2e script. .shipyard/checks/browser.mjs is a Playwright script printing PASS/FAIL per criterion. README documents DATA_DIR temp + SEED_DEMO_DATA=false for browser checks.

conventions.formatting: Prettier: no semis, single quotes, width 100, trailing commas all. Editorconfig: lf, 2 spaces.
conventions.lint: ESLint 9 flat config with eslint-plugin-vue flat/essential and @vue/eslint-config-typescript. Prettier owns style.
conventions.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml: npm ci, format:check, lint, typecheck, test, build, plus docker smoke test
conventions.webStructure: src/api, stores (Pinia), views (*View.vue), components by feature (album/, crate/, forms/, profile/), composables (useXxx.ts), utils (plain functions)
conventions.naming: Vue files PascalCase; composables useXxx.ts; tests *.test.ts next to source
conventions.git: Conventional Commits with scope, e.g. fix(web): ...; ADRs for significant decisions

documentation.gaps: No CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING or CHANGELOG. docs/SPEC.md repo tree is an early plan and differs from the actual files.

relevant.owner: apps/web/src/components/crate/CrateBox.vue owns the sleeve stack. Flip state is v-model:index, driven by apps/web/src/composables/useCrateFlip.ts (goTo, wheel, keys, pointer drag, dragged ref). apps/web/src/views/CrateView.vue binds index to the library store and renders CrateBox, .now text and the Back/Pull/Flip buttons.
relevant.sleeveRendering: apps/web/src/utils/crateLayout.ts: sleevePose(offset), visibleRange(index,count). CrateBox drawn computed slices albums via visibleRange: start = index - VISIBLE_FLIPPED(1) - 1, end = index + 12 + 2. Each is div.sleeve (class current when offset 0) with inline transform, opacity, zIndex from sleevePose.
relevant.flippedSleeves: offset < 0: transform translateZ(40px) rotateX(-55deg), opacity 0, zIndex 101 (above all unflipped sleeves at 100 - depth). Invisible only through opacity 0; still hit-testable. Up to 2 rendered. Sleeves deeper than 12 behind are also opacity 0, with a low zIndex.
relevant.clickHandler: div.sleeve @click=onSleeveClick(offset, album) in CrateBox.vue: if flip.dragged return; if offset===0 emit('open', album); else flip.goTo(index + offset). A click on the invisible offset -1 sleeve calls goTo(index-1), moving back one record.
relevant.tapeLabel: span.crate-label inside div.panel.front in CrateBox.vue (crate.label ?? crate.name). .panel.front is translateZ(70px), bottom -4%, height 42%. Distinct from the .tab crate-picker buttons in CrateView (comments also call those tape labels) and from .divider-tab.
relevant.priorFix: 57302be set .crate { pointer-events: none } and .crate > * { pointer-events: auto } so the tilted crate plane stops swallowing sleeve clicks. No rule disables pointer events on flipped sleeves.
relevant.coverage: CrateBox.test.ts (no layout or hit-testing) has no test for offset<0 sleeves or the front panel. .shipyard/checks/browser.mjs clickCase clicks art only at index 0 on a fresh load and never after a flip; a click 10px below the panel top is logged as OBS with no assertion; nothing clicks .crate-label. Helpers artGeometry and hitAt exist there.
relevant.unverified: The surveyor did not run the app, so the actual hit overlap is unconfirmed.
